rule.combined: improves main every year; paired weekly t>=2; yearly drawdown <=main+0.01; no unresolved positions
rule.decision: both standalone and combined must pass; otherwise reject; all years seen, a pass only permits prospective paper research
rule.sensitivity: Rs300/lot/trade standalone; calls/puts; main losing dates versus whole eligible population; no retuning
rule.exam: 2023 frozen exam remains unchanged and is not opened or extended
